The source prints the instruction only at the first occurrence (s134); the documentary second occurrence (he :52) has no instruction. So the claim 'expanded transcludes only prayer stanzas/refrains' needs qualifying: no navigation cues leak into expanded, but this source instruction does. The runtime word hashes cannot see it: canonical and shabbat_refrains kol_yoshvei have the same he hash (998c…), so nonspoken notes and parentheses are evidently normalized away.
